game.name: Super Mario Odyssey Category Extensions
game.rules:
All runs require video proof (with audio).

It is recommended that every submitted video that includes Daylight Saving Time Abuse (DSTA) start by showing Daylight Saving Time (DST) being set prior to starting the run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, Luigi's Balloon World, and Assist Mode are banned, unless a category explicitly states otherwise.

Runs performed on emulator will not be verified (switch hardware only).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the two mid run.



**Breaks**

If your run uses breaks, choose TA for the Method variable. If it doesn't, choose RTA.

Both start and end of every break must be timestamped in the run description.

Breaks are only allowed during cutscenes; this includes moon animations.

When taking a break, runners should bring up the menu to edit the system time while synchronization with the internet is turned off. This is to ensure that enough time has passed outside of breaks for a seed to be fully grown and the moon to be collected. This option is under "Date and Time" in the switch settings menu. Make sure to confirm the system time with an "A" press at the end of your break so it remains the same as it was at the start of the break.

The pool of available time for breaks gains 15 minutes every 2 hours. Breaks can be taken at any point in the run, and there is no limit on the number of breaks so long as it follows the rules established above.

For example:

- Any run under 2 hours cannot take any breaks.

- Any run between 2 and 4 hours (2:00:00 - 3:59:59) has 15 minutes available for breaks.

- Any run between 4 and 6 hours (4:00:00 - 5:59:59) has 30 minutes available for breaks.

- etc.

Breaks are calculated based on the final run time, so if a runner knows that the run will be over 2 hours they can use from the 15 minute pool instantly. Should mistakes be made, and the run did not hit the required threshold to allow breaks (or did not hit the required threshold to use the amount of break time taken), the run will be retimed.

categories.name: Softlock%
categories.rules:
Get your game into a softlocked state as fast as possible.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you enter a softlocked state. 

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.

categories.name: Close-to-Home%
categories.rules:
Beat the game as fast as possible only using the moons closest to the Odyssey.

The required moon list can be found at: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bP37ce4T92AZhCU3nlSEjEJpdsGns9jOjK5NT2muarY/edit#gid=1687076587

To verify your run you have to scroll through the moon list for each kingdom once the run is over.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you shoot out of the electric wire in the escape sequence.

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, Luigi's Balloon World, and Assist Mode is banned.

categories.name: Dog%
categories.rules:
Collect all 5 Moons that are directly obtained from dogs as fast as possible.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when the final dog moon's icon appears in your inventory.

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode is banned.

categories.name: All NPC Moons (No Toadette)
categories.rules:
Collect all NPC (Non-Player Character) moons as fast as possible. This does not include Toadette Achievements.

Time begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when the moon icon appears in your inventory after collecting the final NPC moon.

All 153 required NPC moons can be found on this list: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1QITU5LuW_Q_Ek_I6q1MbzAqn23b64JobxFnvxRo0SQI/edit

To verify that your run is valid, scroll through the moon list of each kingdom after completing your run.

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.

categories.name: All Toadette Achievements
categories.rules:
Obtain all of Toadette's achievement moons as fast as possible.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when the final toadette moon's icon appears in your inventory.

Buying more than one moon from any shop (duplicate moons) is banned.

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode is banned.

categories.name: [x] All Metro Poles
categories.rules:
Capture and flick all 46 orange poles in Metro Kingdom as fast as possible. Forks do not count. 

Timing starts on the first frame Mario appears after flicking the first pole and ends on the first frame Mario appears after flicking the last pole. 

You may start at any pole. 

You must actually flick out of the pole. Uncapturing without flicking does not count. 

Warps are banned. 

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.

categories.name: 124 Moons
categories.rules:
Get 124 moons as fast as possible.

Timing starts on selecting Start on a new file and ends when the final moon icon appears in your inventory.

If the final moon is a Multimoon, timing ends on the final moon grab.

While not required, it is strongly encouraged to dump all the moons into the Odyssey to show the final moon total.

categories.name: All Captures
categories.rules:
Capture all the enemies/NPCs that are on the ingame capture list as fast as possible.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you capture the final Enemy/NPC.

While not required, it is strongly encouraged to show proof of capturing the required enemies/NPCs by going into capture list ingame after the last capture has been captured.

categories.name: All Coin Stacks
categories.rules:
Collect every coin stack and Luigi/Captain Toad Hint Art as fast as possible from a fresh file.

All Coins in coin stacks must be collected, but Hint Art coins do not.

Darker Side coin stacks are not required.

Time starts when pressing Start and time ends on the first frame of the groundpound of the last hint art or when the coin count goes up for the last coin stack.

categories.name: All Death Animations
categories.rules:
Activate all 10 non-random death animations on a postgame file as fast as possible.

Timing begins when the screen is completely black after skipping the last cutscene while entering the first kingdom and ends when the final animation occurs.

categories.name: All Story Moons
categories.rules:
Beat the game while collecting all moons associated with the main story quests in each kingdom in the intended order.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you shoot out of the electric wire in the escape sequence.

categories.name: All Metro Poles
categories.rules:
Capture and flick all 46 orange poles in Metro Kingdom as fast as possible. Forks do not count.

Timing starts on the first frame Mario appears after flicking the first pole and ends on the first frame Mario appears after flicking the last pole.

You may start at any pole. You may start from any state of Metro Kingdom, as long as all 46 poles are obtainable.

You must actually flick out of the pole. Uncapturing without flicking does not count.

Warps are banned.

categories.name: All Moon Rock Moons
categories.rules:
Break the moon rocks in each kingdom and collect all the moons spawned.

Timing starts when the screen is completely black after skipping the first moon rock's opening cutscene and ends when the final moon’s icon appears in your inventory.

While not required, it is strongly encouraged to show proof of all collected moons using the List feature upon collecting the final moon.

categories.name: All Moons NPG
categories.rules:
Beat Bowser in the Moon Kingdom and collect all moons that are collectable before beating him (462). Any moons that are not available through intended means before post-game are not included.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you shoot out of the wire in the escape sequence with all 462 moons. If you beat Bowser before collecting all 462 moons, then timing ends when the 462nd moon is added to your inventory.

While not required, it is strongly encouraged that you show final moon dump after time ends to ensure all 462 moons are collected.

Please see Game Rules for information regarding breaks.

categories.name: All Music
categories.rules:
Get every music track to appear in the track list.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you show the completed track list.

categories.name: All Signs
categories.rules:
Mash through the text of all 17 signs as fast as possible (not including Koopa Freerunning leaderboards and Jaxi signs).

Timing begins when the screen is completely black after skipping the last cutscene while entering the first kingdom and ends after mashing the last bit of text on the last sign.

categories.name: Damageless
categories.rules:
**SUBMIT MOON COUNT IN MILLISECONDS**

Collect as many unique moons as possible before taking damage.

- Damage that affects Mario's health meter cannot be taken, death counts as well.				
- Moons must be in the Odyssey to count as obtained.				
- Attempt to obtain all 880 Unique Moons.			
- No Duplicate Moons (Extra Shop Moons).				
- Start from a new file (Changing/reloading files mid-attempt is prohibited).				
- Must be done in one sitting (Console cannot be turned off).

categories.name: Darker Side Dupes
categories.rules:
Access the Darker Side of the Moon and collect the Multimoon at the end of the kingdom.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you grab the Multimoon after the Darker Side Dungeon.

Buying more than one moon from any shop (duplicate moons) is allowed.

categories.name: Double Any%
categories.rules:
Beat the game as fast as possible while collecting twice the amount of moons required to leave each kingdom.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you shoot out of the electric wire in the escape sequence.

categories.name: Festival%
categories.rules:
Beat the New Donk City Festival in the Metro Kingdom as fast as possible.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you grab the "A Traditional Festival" Multimoon.

categories.name: Koopa Freerunning RTA
categories.rules:
Complete all Koopa Freerunning races.

Timing begins on GO of first race and ends on FINISH of last race.

A completed file may be used, to skip moon collection animations. Each race only has to be completed once. The races can be completed in any order. Snowline Circuit, Iceburn Circuit, Jump Rope, and RC Car are not included.

categories.name: Maximum Unique Moon Dump
categories.rules:
Dump as many moons into the Odyssey in one globe as possible (630 moons after beating the game with 124 moons, bringing the final total to 754 total moons at the current moment). Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you globe to dump your moons.

The use of saves to prevent accidental globes is allowed:

A safety save may be created during the run and loaded to undo the unintentional moon dump. This safety save shall only be reloaded once, but another one may be created afterwards.

Closing the game and relaunching before autosaving occurs may also be used for the same purpose.

Please see Game Rules for information regarding breaks.

categories.name: Minimum Captures Any%
categories.rules:
**Goal**

Beat the game with as few captures as possible.

**Timing**

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you shoot out of the electric wire in the escape sequence.

The use of saves to prevent accidental captures is allowed:

1. If the capture type is part of the intended route a safety save has to be created during the run and before the accidental capture happens. This safety save shall only be reloaded once, but another one may be created afterwards.

2. If the capture type is not part of the intended route reloading your save (e.g. load another save, reload original save) is allowed as long as the capture list is shown immediately afterwards to proof that the game did not register the capture.

Note: When dying in the escape sequence as Bowser, upon respawning the game considers this to be an additional instance of capturing bowser. If this occurs and is not fixed with a safety save as defined in the rules, it will result in a rejection.

categories.name: Minimum Captures Darker Side
categories.rules:
**Goal**

Access the Darker Side of the Moon and collect the Multimoon at the end of the kingdom with as few captures as possible.

**Timing**

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you grab the Multimoon after the final level.

**General Rules**

Assist Mode is allowed for this run.

Runs may be done in 2 Player Mode. You may switch between 1P and 2P mid run.

Updating the game mid run is banned.

The use of saves to prevent accidental captures is allowed:

1. If the capture type is part of the intended route a safety save has to be created during the run and before the accidental capture happens. This safety save shall only be reloaded once, but another one may be created afterwards.
2. If the capture type is not part of the intended route reloading your save (e.g. load another save, reload original save) is allowed as long as the capture list is shown immediately afterwards to proof that the game did not register the capture.

Please see Game Rules for information regarding breaks.

Note: When dying in the escape sequence as Bowser, upon respawning the game considers this to be an additional instance of capturing bowser. If this occurs and is not fixed with a safety save as defined in the rules, it will result in a rejection.

categories.name: Moon Cave
categories.rules:
Go through the Moon Cave in Moon Kingdom and fight Madame Broode at the end as fast as possible.

Timing begins when the screen fades in after entering the Moon Cave by the Quiet Wall checkpoint and ends after the screen fades out when exiting the Moon Cave.

No setup can be done before the run (cutscenes can't be skipped already, cage can't be broken, etc.)

categories.name: Nipple%
categories.rules:
Get to a shop and buy the Boxer Shorts outfit. Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you select "buy" on the Boxer Shorts outfit in a shop.

Hidden Luigi's from Hint Art are allowed in the Hint Art subcategory.

categories.name: Star%
categories.rules:
Collect a star in the Mushroom Kingdom as fast as possible.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when the moon icon appears in your inventory after collecting a star.

Runs may be done in 2 Player Mode. You may switch between 1P and 2P mid run.

categories.name: Pending
categories.rules:
**Pending: This tab is reserved for potential categories to be added on the leaderboard.                                                      
Proposed categories MUST be submitted for review here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfpT9n8IKzaPdR-pHtHej9IMjBf1flzTAxoyTtWTWtdhCMX5A/viewform                                               
Verified categories must have 3 different runners (6 different runners for partial / postgame categories) with their runs submitted in order to move said category off from Pending.**

levels.name: Cap Kingdom
levels.rules:

Must run on a clean file with no moons or purple coins obtained upon entry and all skippable cutscenes and cinematics still active to be accepted.

values.name: 2P
values.rules: Two player mode may be turned on and off throughout the run.

values.name: 1P
values.rules: One player mode only.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
Beat the game while using Talkatoo as a randomizer for your moons. Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you shoot out of the electric wire in the escape sequence.

Any story moon collected counts towards your moon count required to exit the kingdom and all other moons must be mentioned by Talkatoo. If you collect a non-story moon that was not mentioned by Talkatoo then it does not count towards your moon count required to leave the kingdom. (ex. Wooded Kingdom requires 16 moons to leave. There are 8 story moons available to you that can be collected at any time you would like. Any other moons you collect must be mentioned by Talkatoo in order for them to be counted towards kingdom completion.)

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.

values.name: Hardcore Any%
values.rules:
Beat the game while using Talkatoo as a randomizer for your moons. Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you shoot out of the electric wire in the escape sequence.

All moons must be mentioned by Talkatoo in order to count towards your moon count required to leave the kingdom (except for Ruined Kingdom. In Ruined you just beat the dragon and then leave.) If you collect a moon that was not mentioned by Talkatoo then it does not count towards your moon count required to leave the kingdom. (ex. Wooded Kingdom requires 16 moons to leave, so you must collect 16 moons mentioned by Talkatoo before leaving.)

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.

values.name: World Peace
values.rules:
Complete World Peace while using Talkatoo as a randomizer for your moons. Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you shoot out of the electric wire in the escape sequence. 

Any story moon collected counts towards your moon count required to exit the kingdom and all other moons must be mentioned by Talkatoo. If you collect a non-story moon that was not mentioned by Talkatoo then it does not count towards your moon count required to leave the kingdom.(ex. Wooded Kingdom requires 16 moons to leave. There are 8 story moons required to get World Peace in Wooded Kingdom, so you will need to collect 8 moons that are mentioned by Talkatoo before leaving.)

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.

values.name: All Metro Poles (archive)
values.rules:
Capture and flick all 46 orange poles in Metro Kingdom as fast as possible. Forks do not count.

Timing starts on the first frame Mario appears after flicking the first pole and ends on the first frame Mario appears after flicking the last pole.

You may start at any pole.

You must actually flick out of the pole. Uncapturing without flicking does not count.

Warps are banned.

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.

Versions 1.0.0, 1.0.1, and 1.1.0 only.

Digital 1.1.0 is banned.
Versions 1.2.0 and 1.3.0 only.

values.name: No Revisits
values.rules:
Access the Dark Side of the Moon and beat the Broodal boss rush without revisiting any kingdoms.

Revisiting a kingdom is defined as entering the kingdom a second time throughout the run.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you grab the Multimoon after the Broodal Mech fight.

Buying more than one moon in the Mushroom Kingdom shop is banned.

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.

values.name: New Game
values.rules:
Collect all Purple/Regional Coins in every kingdom.

Timing begins when selecting "Start" on a new file and ends when you collect the last Purple/Regional Coin.

While not required, it is strongly encouraged to show proof of all collected coins using the List feature upon collecting the last one.

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

While not required, it is strongly encouraged that right before the start of the run show that no purple coins have been collected so far. You can do this using the list feature, and after the run has ended it is also encouraged to use said feature to prove that all regional coins have been collected.

All runs require video proof (with audio).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

games.name: Super Mario Odyssey Category Extensions
games.rules:
All runs require video proof (with audio).

It is recommended that every submitted video that includes Daylight Saving Time Abuse (DSTA) start by showing Daylight Saving Time (DST) being set prior to starting the run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, Luigi's Balloon World, and Assist Mode are banned, unless a category explicitly states otherwise.

Runs performed on emulator will not be verified (switch hardware only).

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the two mid run.



**Breaks**

If your run uses breaks, choose TA for the Method variable. If it doesn't, choose RTA.

Both start and end of every break must be timestamped in the run description.

Breaks are only allowed during cutscenes; this includes moon animations.

When taking a break, runners should bring up the menu to edit the system time while synchronization with the internet is turned off. This is to ensure that enough time has passed outside of breaks for a seed to be fully grown and the moon to be collected. This option is under "Date and Time" in the switch settings menu. Make sure to confirm the system time with an "A" press at the end of your break so it remains the same as it was at the start of the break.

The pool of available time for breaks gains 15 minutes every 2 hours. Breaks can be taken at any point in the run, and there is no limit on the number of breaks so long as it follows the rules established above.

For example:

- Any run under 2 hours cannot take any breaks.

- Any run between 2 and 4 hours (2:00:00 - 3:59:59) has 15 minutes available for breaks.

- Any run between 4 and 6 hours (4:00:00 - 5:59:59) has 30 minutes available for breaks.

- etc.

Breaks are calculated based on the final run time, so if a runner knows that the run will be over 2 hours they can use from the 15 minute pool instantly. Should mistakes be made, and the run did not hit the required threshold to allow breaks (or did not hit the required threshold to use the amount of break time taken), the run will be retimed.

Warps are banned.

Runs must be done entirely with your switch in docked or undocked mode, you may not switch between the 2 mid run.

Use of Amiibo, 2P, and Assist Mode are banned.
